name: Company Blade
title: The Red Steel
examine: Boiled leather, a red sash, and the stillness of somebody paid by the hour to be exactly here. The mask is pushed up, off duty until it is not.
lines: Walk where the braziers are. The dark parts are dark for Company reasons.
The Captain pays on time. You would be amazed what that buys in loyalty.
No blades drawn in the hall. House rule. The house has never needed a second rule.
